senses.gloss: to tie dry ears; to bind sheaves.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 37:7">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXVII, 7</cite> (v. <cite ref="K01164"><he>כְּרִיכָא</he> II</cite>).
<cite ref="Shabbat 155b:2">Sabb. 155ᵇ</cite> <he>מפָרְכִינָן תבן וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>מפרכין</he>; Ms. O. <he>מפספסין</he>) we may untie bundles of straw and of clover and mix them.

senses.gloss: to be tied up. Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᶜ (ref. to תאלמנה, Ps. XXXI, 19) יִתְפַּרְכַן let them (their lips) be tied up (with ref. to מאלמים, Gen. XXXVII, 7, v. supra); [v. חֲרַשׁ, a. correct tied for crushed]; Gen. R. s. 1 אִתְפַּרְכַן.
